summary: This room is the BLUELINE hand-drawn-3D pipeline made visible as a topology, not a folder tree: root concepts (Blocked, Not Prompted; ControlNet as Topology; Hand-Drawn 3D Look), Shop specialists (Blender, ComfyUI, Figure Rig, SAM, Depth Anything, LaMa), and Projects (BLUELINE, LDN RTM) are already densely cross-linked to each other — this community is coherent, not cluttered, once you see it as one graph. The real gaps were at the edges: a handful of genuinely new entries (OBS, LoRA Trainer, Block It in Blender — Ink It in genAI) sit almost unlinked next to a cluster that would obviously want them, and one entry — Blocked, Not Prompted — is the unmarked keystone of the whole cluster (14 inbound, cited as "core mechanism" by nearly everything here) yet carries neither a forward_vector nor a hero image and is staged as "seed." One merge is already decided and just needs finishing (Line-Art Layer Decomposition → Animate the Background). The five directed flags were all genuine and confirmable — real duplicate-recipe pointers and one under-served roster table, not busywork.
